The next available slot is Thursday at two.
Please bring your insurance card and a valid photo ID.
If you need to cancel, please call at least twenty-four hours before your appointment.
New patients are asked to arrive fifteen minutes early to complete their registration paperwork.
Please let us know in advance if you require a translator or any other special accommodation.
After your visit, the doctor may send prescriptions directly to your preferred pharmacy, so please provide that information.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 78) | Recycling Center
scenario: You are learning to assist visitors at a recycling center.

sentences.text: Welcome to the recycling center.
Please separate your items by material type.
Glass, paper, plastic, and metal must each go in different bins.
Hazardous waste such as batteries and paint must be dropped off at the dedicated hazardous waste station.
Electronic devices like phones and computers can be recycled for free at our e-waste collection point.
Items that are still in usable condition can be donated at the thrift store located just next to the main facility.
By recycling correctly today, you are helping reduce landfill waste and contributing to a healthier environment for future generations.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 79) | Electronics Store
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at an electronics store.

sentences.text: Welcome, how can I help?
What type of device are you looking for?
This model has the best battery life in its price range.
We offer a two-year extended warranty for an additional charge.
All purchases can be returned within thirty days provided the item is in its original condition.
Our technicians are available in store to help you set up your new device before you leave.
If you are trading in an old device, bring it with you and we will apply the trade-in value toward your new purchase.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 80) | Veterinary Clinic
scenario: You are learning to assist pet owners at a veterinary clinic.

sentences.text: Please have a seat here.
What seems to be wrong with your pet?
We will take your pet's weight and temperature first.
Please keep your pet on a leash or in its carrier while in the waiting area.
Annual vaccinations and parasite prevention are important parts of keeping your pet healthy.
The vet may recommend some diagnostic tests such as blood work or an X-ray to make a diagnosis.
If your pet requires surgery, you will need to sign a consent form and leave your pet with us for the day.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 81) | Community College Registration Office
scenario: You are learning to assist students at a community college registration office.

sentences.text: Welcome, do you have a student ID?
Which course are you looking to register for?
That class still has open seats this semester.
Some courses have prerequisites that must be completed before enrolling.
You can register online, by phone, or in person at this office.
Tuition payment is due within one week of registration to secure your spot in the class.
If you need to withdraw from a course, please do so before the official deadline to avoid receiving a failing grade on your academic record.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 82) | Hardware Store
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a hardware store.

sentences.text: Welcome, what are you working on today?
Those items are in aisle seven.
This drill is our best seller for home use.
Make sure to wear safety goggles when cutting or sanding materials.
We offer free equipment rental for large tools if you only need them for one job.
If you are not sure which materials to buy, our staff can help you create a list based on your project.
All power tools purchased in store come with a thirty-day return policy, provided the item has not been damaged and the original packaging is intact.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 83) | Dental Clinic
scenario: You are learning to assist patients at a dental clinic.

sentences.text: Please fill out this health form.
When did you last visit a dentist?
The dentist will take a few X-rays first.
Please rinse your mouth with this solution before we begin.
It is recommended to brush twice a day and floss at least once a day.
If you experience sensitivity or pain after the procedure, please contact us right away.
We recommend scheduling a routine cleaning and checkup every six months to help detect any issues early and maintain good oral health.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 84) | Hotel Front Desk
scenario: You are learning to assist guests at a hotel front desk.

sentences.text: Welcome, do you have a reservation?
May I see your photo ID and credit card?
Check-out time is eleven in the morning.
Breakfast is served in the dining room from six to ten each morning.
If you need extra towels or pillows, please call housekeeping from your room phone.
The hotel gym and swimming pool are open twenty-four hours and are accessible with your room key card.
Please be aware that any damages to the room or incidental charges will be settled automatically against the credit card on file at checkout.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 85) | Community Food Bank
scenario: You are learning to assist visitors at a community food bank.

sentences.text: Welcome, we are glad you are here.
Please sign in at the front table.
Food is distributed on Tuesdays and Fridays from nine to noon.
Each household receives one bag of groceries per visit per week.
Please let us know if anyone in your household has a food allergy or dietary requirement.
We also have a clothing section and hygiene supply station available for families in need.
If you would like to volunteer or make a donation, please speak with the coordinator at the desk, as we rely entirely on community support to serve our neighbors.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 86) | Blood Donation Center
scenario: You are learning to assist donors at a blood donation center.

sentences.text: Thank you so much for coming in today.
Please fill out this health screening form.
Have you eaten and had plenty of water today?
The donation itself takes about 10 minutes once you are settled.
Please wait in the recovery area for 15 minutes after your donation.
Donors are asked to avoid strenuous exercise for the remainder of the day after giving blood.
You are eligible to donate whole blood once every 56 days, and your contribution can help save up to three lives with a single donation.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 87) | Fitness Gym
scenario: You are learning to sign up new members at a fitness gym.

sentences.text: Welcome to our fitness center.
We offer monthly and annual membership plans.
All new members receive a free session with a personal trainer.
The gym is open 7 days a week from 5:00 in the morning until midnight.
Members are asked to wipe down all equipment after use as a courtesy to others.
If you decide to cancel your membership, written notice must be provided at least 30 days in advance.
Our premium plan includes unlimited group fitness classes, access to the sauna, and priority booking for personal training appointments throughout the year.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 88) | Public Aquatic Center
scenario: You are learning to assist visitors at a public aquatic center.

sentences.text: Welcome to the aquatic center.
Please shower before entering the pool.
Running on the pool deck is strictly prohibited.
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
Lane swimming is available during lap hours from 6:00 to 8:00 every morning.
Proper swimwear is required and street clothes are not permitted in the pool.
Swimming lessons for children and adults are offered in 6-week sessions, and registration opens online on the 1st of each month.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 89) | Immigration Office
scenario: You are learning to assist applicants at an immigration office.

sentences.text: Please take a number and wait.
Do you have an appointment scheduled?
Please submit all original documents along with one copy of each.
Your current visa status must remain valid throughout the application process.
Processing times depend on the type of application and the volume of cases being handled.
You will receive a written notice by mail once a decision has been made on your application.
If your circumstances change after submitting your application, such as a change of address or employment, you must notify this office in writing as soon as possible.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 90) | Yoga Studio
scenario: You are learning to welcome students at a yoga studio.

sentences.text: Welcome. Please remove your shoes at the door.
Mats are available to borrow at the front desk.
Please arrive a few minutes early to settle in.
Let me know if you have any injuries I should be aware of.
Focus on your breathing throughout the class and move at your own pace.
We ask that you turn off your phone or put it on silent before entering the studio.
New students are welcome to try their first class for free, and we offer a range of weekly membership plans to suit different schedules and budgets.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 91) | Bakery
scenario: You are learning to serve customers at a bakery.

sentences.text: Good morning. What can I get you?
Our sourdough is fresh out of the oven.
We bake new batches every morning at 6:00.
Custom cakes require at least three days notice to prepare.
All of our pastries are made with locally sourced butter and organic flour.
If you have any dietary restrictions, such as gluten or nut allergies, please let us know before ordering.
We also offer a subscription service where you can pre-order your weekly bread and pick it up every Saturday morning without waiting in line.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 92) | Pharmacy
scenario: You are learning to assist patients at a pharmacy.

sentences.text: Can I have your prescription, please?
Your medication will be ready in about 15 minutes.
Take one tablet twice a day with food.
Do not take this medication with alcohol or certain other drugs.
Please let me know if you experience any unusual side effects after starting this prescription.
If you are taking other medications, it is important to inform your pharmacist to check for possible interactions.
For chronic conditions, we offer an automatic refill service so your medication is ready for pickup before you run out.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 93) | Bank
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a bank.

sentences.text: How can I help you today?
Please provide your account number and ID.
Your balance as of this morning is shown on the screen.
There is a daily withdrawal limit of $500 at the ATM.
If you would like to open a savings account, I can connect you with one of our advisers.
Please sign here to confirm the transaction and I will provide you with a printed receipt.
If you notice any unauthorized charges on your account, please contact us immediately so we can place a temporary hold and begin an investigation.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 94) | Tax Preparation Office
scenario: You are learning to assist clients at a tax preparation office.

sentences.text: Please have a seat.
Did you bring all your income documents?
We will need your W-2 forms and any records of additional income.
Filing your return early helps avoid delays and reduces the risk of identity fraud.
If you are self-employed, please bring receipts for all business-related expenses you wish to deduct.
Any taxes owed must be paid by the official deadline to avoid late payment penalties and interest charges.
We recommend keeping copies of your tax returns and supporting documents for at least 7 years in case of a future audit by the tax authority.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 95) | Post Office
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a post office.

sentences.text: Next in line, please.
Where would you like to send this package?
Please place the parcel on the scale.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
You can track your package online using the tracking number on your receipt.
Fragile items should be wrapped in bubble wrap and surrounded by packing materials to prevent damage.
If your package exceeds the maximum weight or size limits, it will need to be sent through our freight service at a different rate.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 96) | Pet Store
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a pet store.

sentences.text: Welcome. Are you looking for anything specific?
What kind of pet do you have at home?
This brand is highly recommended by veterinarians.
Small animals and reptiles require a controlled temperature environment at home.
We offer free nutrition consultations for pet owners who want guidance on the right diet.
All animals sold in our store come with a health guarantee and veterinary health check certificate.
If you are adopting a pet for the first time, we recommend speaking with one of our specialists who can walk you through everything you will need to get started.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 97) | City Hall Office
scenario: You are learning to assist applicants at a city hall office.

sentences.text: Please take a number and wait.
Both applicants must be present to apply.
You each need to provide a valid government-issued photo ID.
The license is valid for 60 days from the date it is issued.
There is a standard fee of $75 payable by cash or card.
If either applicant was previously married, you must provide a copy of the divorce decree or death certificate.
Once the license is issued, the ceremony must be performed by an authorized officiant, and the signed license must be returned to this office within 10 days.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 98) | Child Care Center
scenario: You are learning to assist parents at a child care center.

sentences.text: Welcome. Is this your first visit?
Please complete the enrollment form today.
Drop off is between 7:00 and 9:00 each morning.
We ask that you pack a labeled lunch and two snacks for your child.
Please notify us in advance if someone other than a parent will be picking up your child.
Children with a fever or contagious illness must stay home until they have been symptom-free for at least 24 hours.
Al Story Fuller's a structured daily routine that includes outdoor play, learning activities, story time, and rest time to support each child's development.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 99) | Bicycle Shop
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a bicycle shop.

sentences.text: Welcome. What brings you in today?
Is this for commuting or recreational riding?
I will do a quick safety check on your bike.
Your brake pads are worn and should be replaced soon.
We recommend servicing your bike at least once a year to keep it running smoothly.
Helmets and lights are required by law in many areas, so make sure you have both before riding.
If you are buying a new bike, we offer a free 30-day tune-up after purchase to make any adjustments once you have had a chance to ride it regularly.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 100) | Dry Cleaning Shop
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a dry cleaning shop.

sentences.text: What items do you need cleaned today?
Please check your pockets before leaving garments with us.
This suit will be ready for pick up by Thursday.
We recommend dry cleaning wool and silk items rather than washing them at home.
Please point out any stains when you drop off so we can treat them properly.
Items not picked up within 30 days will be donated to charity after we attempt to contact you.
For delicate or designer garments, we offer a premium hand finishing service that ensures every detail is carefully pressed and inspected before return.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 101) | Public Library
scenario: You are learning to assist visitors at a public library.

sentences.text: Welcome to the library.
Do you have a library card with us?
Books can be borrowed for up to 3 weeks.
Please keep your voice low to avoid disturbing other visitors.
You can renew your books online, by phone, or in person before the due date.
If a book you need is not available, you can place a hold and we will notify you when it is ready.
Our library also offers free access to digital newspapers, audiobooks, and academic databases for all registered cardholders.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 102) | Catering Company
scenario: You are learning to assist clients at a catering company.

sentences.text: Welcome. Tell us about your event.
How many guests are you expecting?
We offer buffet, plated, and family-style service options.
A tasting session can be arranged once you have selected your preferred menu.
We require a deposit of 30% to confirm and reserve your event date.
Please inform us of any dietary restrictions or allergies at least one week before the event.
Our team will arrive 2 hours before your event to set up, and we handle all cleanup and equipment removal once the event has concluded.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 104) | Car Rental Agency
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a car rental agency.

sentences.text: Do you have a reservation with us?
May I see your driver's license and credit card?
Please inspect the car for existing damage before driving off.
The vehicle must be returned with a full tank of gas.
We offer optional insurance coverage for an additional daily fee.
Returning the vehicle late may result in an additional charge based on our hourly rate.
If the car breaks down during your rental period, please call our 24-hour roadside assistance line and a representative will be dispatched to help you.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 105) | Flower Shop
scenario: You are learning to assist customers at a flower shop.

sentences.text: Welcome. What is the occasion?
These roses are freshly delivered this morning.
We can add a personalized card to any arrangement.
Same-day delivery is available for orders placed before noon.
For weddings and events, we recommend booking your flowers at least 4 weeks in advance.
Keep your flowers in fresh water and trim the stems every 2 days to extend their life.
We also offer a weekly subscription service where a fresh seasonal arrangement is delivered to your home or office every Monday morning.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 106) | Museum
scenario: You are learning to guide visitors at a museum.

sentences.text: Welcome to the museum.
Please keep your voice low inside the galleries.
Photography is allowed, but flash is not permitted.
The special exhibition on the second floor closes at 4:00 today.
Audio guides are available at the entrance desk for a small rental fee.
Please do not touch any of the artifacts or artworks as the oils from your hands can cause damage over time.
School groups and organized tours are asked to check in with the education department at least 2 weeks before their scheduled visit.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 107) | University Admissions Office
scenario: You are learning to assist students at a university admissions office.

sentences.text: Welcome to the admissions office.
Have you submitted all required documents?
The application deadline is the 31st of this month.
You will receive a decision letter within 4 to 6 weeks of submission.
International students must also provide proof of English language proficiency.
Financial aid applications should be submitted at the same time as your admissions application for priority consideration.
Once you are accepted and confirm your enrollment, you will receive instructions for course registration, student ID issuance, and orientation week attendance.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 108) | Airport Check-In Counter
scenario: You are learning to assist travelers at an airport check-in counter.

sentences.text: May I see your passport and booking reference?
Would you prefer a window or aisle seat?
Your bag is slightly over the weight limit.
Please proceed to gate 14 after clearing security.
Boarding begins 45 minutes before departure, so please do not arrive late.
Liquids in your carry-on bag must be in containers of 100 ml or less and placed in a clear zip lock bag.
If your flight is delayed or cancelled, please proceed to the airline service desk in the main terminal for rebooking assistance and information.

title: TOEFL (2026) Speaking Task 1 (Practice 109) | Grocery Store
scenario: You are learning to assist shoppers at a grocery store.

sentences.text: Welcome. Can I help you find something?
The dairy section is in the back of the store.
Weekly sale items are marked with a yellow tag.
Please check the expiration dates on perishable items before placing them in your cart.
Our loyalty card gives you access to member only discounts on hundreds of products every week.
If an item on your receipt rings up at the wrong price, please bring it to the customer service desk.
We also offer online ordering with same-day delivery or curbside pickup, which you can set up through our store website or mobile app.
